info.title: RaceDay API
info.description: RESTful API for the RaceDay event management system. Register, then call POST /api/auth/login. The session cookie is stored by the browser and sent automatically, so every endpoint can be tried from this page.

post.summary: Logs in and starts a session.
post.description:
Public. Expects email and password. On success a session cookie is issued that carries the user's id and
role for all later requests. Returns 200 with user id, email and role; 401 for invalid credentials.

post.summary: Logs out and ends the current session.
post.description: Any authenticated user. Returns 200 once the session cookie is cleared; 401 if not logged in.

get.summary: Lists the categories of an event.
get.description: Public. Returns 200 with the event's categories; 404 if the event does not exist.

post.summary: Adds a category to an event (owning Organiser only).

delete.description:
Returns 204 on success; 401 if not logged in; 403 if not an Organiser or not the owner; 404 if not found;
409 if participants are already enrolled in the category.

post.summary: Enters an event under a chosen category (Participant only).

get.summary: Lists everyone enrolled in an event (owning Organiser only).
get.description:
Returns 200 with the enrolments; 401 if not logged in; 403 if not an Organiser or not the event's owner;
404 if the event does not exist.

get.summary: Lists the logged-in Participant's own enrolments.
get.description: Returns 200 with the enrolments; 401 if not logged in; 403 if not a Participant.

delete.summary: Withdraws from an event (owning Participant only).
delete.description:
Returns 204 on success; 401 if not logged in; 403 if not a Participant or not your enrolment;
404 if not found; 409 if a result has already been captured for this enrolment.

get.description: Public. Returns 200 with every event, soonest first.

post.description:
Expects name, optional description, event date, location, distance in km and event type (Run, Walk or Cycle).
The logged-in Organiser becomes the event's owner.
Returns 201 with the event; 400 for validation errors; 401 if not logged in; 403 if not an Organiser.

get.description: Public. Returns 200 with the event; 404 if it does not exist.

delete.description:
Also removes the event's categories, enrolments and results.
Returns 204 on success; 401 if not logged in; 403 if not an Organiser or not the owner; 404 if not found.

post.summary: Captures a participant's finish time and position (owning Organiser only).

get.summary: Lists all results for an event (owning Organiser only).
get.description:
Returns 200 with the results ordered by finish position; 401 if not logged in;
403 if not an Organiser or not the event's owner; 404 if the event does not exist.

put.summary: Corrects a captured result (owning Organiser only).

get.summary: Lists the logged-in Participant's own results.
get.description: Returns 200 with the participant's results across events; 401 if not logged in; 403 if not a Participant.

post.summary: Publishes race results for an event (owning Organiser only).
post.description:
Returns 200 when results are published successfully.
Returns 401 if not authenticated,
403 if not the event's owning Organiser,
and 404 if the event does not exist.

get.summary: Gets the logged-in user's own profile.
get.description: Any authenticated user. Returns 200 with profile details; 401 if not logged in.

put.summary: Updates the logged-in user's own profile.
put.description:
Any authenticated user. Expects first name, last name and optional phone number.
Returns 200 with the updated profile; 400 for validation errors; 401 if not logged in.

finishTime.description: Finish time as hh:mm:ss (must be greater than zero).
Finish time as hh:mm:ss (must be greater than zero).
